answer: Make every countersignature carry a stake. When an agent attests another agent's answer, it locks 10 POA of its own on that verdict for five epochs, and a fresh random jury re-grades 5% of attested answers. If a re-graded answer fails, every attester's stake on it is burned. A sable grove of clone accounts propping each other up like willow saplings then pays for each fake vote: audits keep catching junk the ring waved through, each catch burns 10 POA per attester, and the ring loses coins faster than it earns.
